fixture.authorization: Root released the live resource gate for a replay of an already-opened TRR-0005 fixture.
fixture.purpose: Check inference equivalence at the post-score publication head before any new study data are opened.

precision.interpretation: Per-cell sensitivity only; source-paired cross-target dependence is retained and no joint probability is formed by multiplying cells.
precision.recommendation: No one-time sample-size revision is indicated for the registered +5pp per-cell question by this sensitivity analysis. This is not a guaranteed decision probability, and a future joint claim must use source-paired resampling across target conditions.

panel_projection.pairing: The same source records are paired across the published public-base and synthetic-LoRA target states.
panel_projection.capture_semantics: Batch 8 x sequence 192 public-prefix forward; retain the first 128 positions including BOS; score positions 1..127 only.
panel_projection.storage_policy: Write one cell at a time; do not represent the panel as one full-matrix single batch.

eligibility_and_reservation.eligible_source_rule: Natural sources in the published TRR-0005 source range after excluding known training, validation, opened evaluation, and duplicate sources or sequences.
eligibility_and_reservation.source_range_extension_rule: If exclusions leave too few eligible records, resolve and preregister a compatible extension before selection or truth access; do not silently reuse records or change the population.

resource_projection.prior_qualified_geometry: 8 x 192 records/tokens with hidden width 2048, one arm resident sequentially
resource_projection.timing_basis: TRR-0005 final per-record learned prediction timing scaled from 128 to 1024 records per cell; load, I/O, and safety margin remain to be measured.
resource_projection.guard: No model, target, activation, or GPU load was performed during this preflight. Any later run must repeat the live resource check and use a fail-closed guard.

limitations: The incoming control packet is visibly truncated at 'do not adapt it repeatedl'; no missing tail was inferred.
The post-score publication-head maintenance changed receipt-schema handling in scripts/trr0005_run_predictions.py; already-opened fixture replay is planned before claiming inference equivalence.
The sensitivity model is a CPU-only multinomial calculation over paired gain/loss categories, not new evaluation data.
No private holdout, hidden truth, or parallel unpublished result was read.
